dgm-aider-polyglot.reference_check: Scorer check in the image: the Exercism reference solutions of all 225 exercises pass their hidden tests (exit status 0 and framework summary with at least one passed and no failed test; 225/225, 213.6 s with 3 parallel containers), and the unchanged stubs fail on 219/225. The 6 stubs that pass are refactoring or test-writing exercises: go__counter, go__ledger, go__markdown, java__ledger, java__tree-building, javascript__ledger; none is in the 10-exercise list, and an agent that changes nothing scores 0 there (DGM's empty-patch rule). No run had exit status 0 without a passing summary. Unit tests repeat the check for one exercise per language.
dgm-aider-polyglot.dgm_protocol_verified: DGM paper (arXiv 2505.22954) Sec. 4.2 and App. E.3 list the 10 exercises as the first stage that verifies basic coding ability; DGM_outer.py loads polyglot/subsets/small.json and medium.json and self_improve_step.run_harness_polyglot runs the medium list only when at least 40% of the small list is resolved

seed_cached_replay_after_memory_cap.note: the agent sandbox memory cap was lowered from 1024 MB to 512 MB after the fresh runs; a cached replay gives the same per-exercise outcomes

llm_spend_note: All OpenRouter spend of this package: a one-exercise probe (0.003152), three fresh seed evaluations on the 10-exercise list (0.030417, 0.043521, 0.025532) and one fresh seed evaluation on DGM's 50-exercise list (0.131362); replays and tests used cached replies or a fake client. Budget 2.00.
related_records: rqgm-polyglot-coding stays recorded as a duplicate of dgm-aider-polyglot (catalog/withdrawn.json), since this task is now implemented with the six toolchains. RQGM's Polyglot splits of 10/49/166 items add up to the 225 exercises and match the sizes of DGM's small list, the 49 medium exercises outside it and the remaining 166 (subset 'heldout' here); the exact split membership in RQGM was not checked.
